verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own Mail MCP server gives AI assistants programmatic access to core inbox and calendar actions: reading, summarizing, drafting, sending, scheduling and follow-up nudges. However, there is no documented public REST API (OpenAPI probes returned 404), nothing claims parity with the full UI, and every send requires explicit user approval. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API, programmatic coverage of UI features like Auto Labels, Split Inbox, Snippets, team comments and settings, a stated UI/API parity guarantee, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools. You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar
Every send action requires your explicit approval, so you stay in control.
